description_en: Queries the delivery groups for which a specified user has obtained access permissions through delivery group-level authorization by paging, with support for fuzzy filtering by delivery group ID, delivery group name, application ID, or application name
description_zh: 分页查询指定用户通过交付组级授权获得访问权限的交付组，可按交付组 ID、交付组名称、应用 ID、应用名称进行模糊筛选
name: ListAuthorizedAppInstanceGroupByUser

parameters.help_en:
The product type. The value must match the product type of the delivery groups to query. Only delivery groups of the specified product type are returned.

Valid values:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud Application.
CloudBrowser: cloud browser.
WuyingServer: Enterprise Edition workstation.
WuyingWorkstation: Personal Edition Lingjun container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationTeam: Team Edition Lingjun container workstation.
WuyingWorkstationBusiness: Dedicated Edition Lingjun container workstation.
AndroidCloud: cloud phone.
AIAgent: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值需与被查询交付组的产品类型一致，只返回该产品类型下的交付组。

取值：

CloudApp：无影云应用。
CloudBrowser：云浏览器。
WuyingServer：企业版工作站。
WuyingWorkstation：个人版灵构容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationTeam：灵构团队版容器工作站。
WuyingWorkstationBusiness：灵构专属版容器工作站。
AndroidCloud：云手机。
AIAgent：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of delivery groups to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的交付组数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID. Fuzzy matching is supported: delivery groups whose IDs contain the specified string are returned. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the delivery group ID.

If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by delivery group ID is applied
parameters.help_zh:
交付组 ID，支持模糊匹配：返回 ID 中包含该字符串的交付组。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 接口获取。

不传入时不按交付组 ID 筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Fuzzy matching is supported: delivery groups that contain a deployed application whose ID includes the specified string are returned. You can obtain the application ID from the Apps list returned by this operation.

If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by application ID is applied
parameters.help_zh:
应用 ID，支持模糊匹配：返回已部署应用的 ID 中包含该字符串的交付组。应用 ID 可从本接口返回的 Apps 列表中获取。

不传入时不按应用 ID 筛选
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The username. An exact match is performed on the username to query the delivery groups for which the user has been granted delivery group-level authorization.

This parameter is required. If this parameter is not specified, the error code `InvalidParameter.UserId` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
用户名，按用户名精确匹配，查询该用户已获得交付组级授权的交付组。

该参数必填。未传入时返回错误码 `InvalidParameter.UserId`
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group name. Fuzzy matching is supported. For example, if you set this parameter to `Office App`, delivery groups whose names contain `Office App` (such as `My Office App` or `Office App A`) are returned.

If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by delivery group name is applied
parameters.help_zh:
交付组名称，支持模糊匹配。例如，填写 `办公应用`，则名称中包含 `办公应用` 的交付组（如 `我的办公应用`、`办公应用A`）都会被查询到。

不传入时不按交付组名称筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The application name. Fuzzy matching is supported: delivery groups that contain a deployed application whose name includes the specified string are returned.

If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by application name is applied
parameters.help_zh:
应用名称，支持模糊匹配：返回已部署应用的名称中包含该字符串的交付组。

不传入时不按应用名称筛选
parameters.name: app_name

AppInstanceGroupModels.description_en: The list of authorized delivery groups on the current page. This is an empty list if the user has no authorized delivery groups that match the conditions
AppInstanceGroupModels.description_zh: 当前页的已授权交付组列表。用户没有符合条件的授权交付组时为空列表

AppCenterImageId.description_en: The ID of the application image used by the delivery group
AppCenterImageId.description_zh: 交付组使用的应用镜像 ID

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The delivery group ID. You can pass this value to the [GetConnectionTicket](~~GetConnectionTicket~~) operation to specify the delivery group to connect to
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 交付组 ID。调用 [GetConnectionTicket](~~GetConnectionTicket~~) 接口时，可传入此值指定连接的交付组

AppInstanceType.description_en: The specification type of the delivery group

Apps.description_en: The list of applications deployed in the delivery group. This list includes all deployed applications in the delivery group image and is not affected by the AppId or AppName request parameters
Apps.description_zh: 该交付组已部署的应用列表，包含交付组镜像中的全部已部署应用，不受请求参数 AppId、AppName 的筛选影响

AppIcon.description_en: The URL of the application icon

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Pass this value to the [GetConnectionTicket](~~GetConnectionTicket~~) operation to obtain a connection ticket for the application
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID。调用 [GetConnectionTicket](~~GetConnectionTicket~~) 接口获取该应用的连接凭证时，传入此值

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the delivery group. The value is in the ISO 8601 datetime format with milliseconds and a time zone offset. The returned time zone offset is +00:00. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 交付组到期时间。ISO 8601 日期时间格式，包含毫秒和时区偏移，返回的时区偏移为 +00:00。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the delivery group. The value is in the ISO 8601 datetime format with milliseconds and a time zone offset. The returned time zone offset is +00:00. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm
GmtCreate.description_zh: 交付组创建时间。ISO 8601 日期时间格式，包含毫秒和时区偏移，返回的时区偏移为 +00:00。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the delivery group. For more information about supported regions, see [Limits]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html）
RegionId.description_zh: 交付组所属的地域 ID。关于支持的地域详情，请参见[使用限制]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426036.html）

Status.description_en:
The delivery group status. Valid values:

DEPLOYING: The delivery group is being created or starting resources and is not yet connectable.
DEPLOYED: The delivery group is deployed. Resources are ready but the delivery group has not been listed for service.
PUBLISHED: The delivery group is published and listed. Users can connect to and use the delivery group.
STOPPING: The delivery group is being delisted and is stopping service.
STOPPED: The delivery group is delisted and has stopped service. Users cannot connect.
MAINTAINING: The delivery group is being maintained or updated.
FAILED: The delivery group failed to publish. Resource initialization failed.
MAINTAIN_FAILED: The update failed. Maintenance or changes were not successful.
DELETING: The delivery group is being deleted.

Deleted delivery groups are not returned
Status.description_zh:
交付组状态。取值：

DEPLOYING：发布中，交付组正在创建或启动资源，暂不可连接。
DEPLOYED：已部署，资源就绪但尚未上架对外提供服务。
PUBLISHED：发布成功，交付组已上架，用户可正常连接使用。
STOPPING：下架中，交付组正在停止服务。
STOPPED：已下架，交付组已停止服务，用户无法连接。
MAINTAINING：更新中，交付组正在进行维护或变更。
FAILED：发布失败，资源初始化失败。
MAINTAIN_FAILED：更新失败，维护或变更未成功。
DELETING：删除中，交付组正在被删除。

已删除的交付组不会返回

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number. This value is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，与请求参数 PageNumber 一致

PageSize.description_en: The number of delivery groups returned per page. This value is the same as the PageSize request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的交付组数量，与请求参数 PageSize 一致

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of authorized delivery groups that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的已授权交付组总数
